priorityList: Summon your pet and cast Cataclysm or Soul Fire as the fight begins.
Summon Infernal on cooldown, ideally syncing it with Malevolence, Trinkets, and Potions.
Cast Ruination immediately whenever it becomes available.
Apply Havoc to a secondary target if Infernal is not active and the target will live at least 8 seconds.
Cast Rain of Fire when facing 4 or more enemies, especially if you have high Shards or the Alythess's Ire buff.
Cast Chaos Bolt instead of Rain of Fire if there are 3 or fewer enemies.
Cast Chaos Bolt regardless of target count if Demonic Art is active or the Diabolic Ritual is about to expire.
Use Cataclysm on cooldown to apply Immolate to all targets and benefit from Lake of Fire.
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if you have Fiendish Cruelty or Conflagration of Chaos procs.
Use Conflagrate to generate Shards and Backdraft stacks, ensuring you don't overcap Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Soul Fire if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards and the enemy count is low (5 or fewer targets).
Manually refresh Immolate on targets if Cataclysm is on cooldown and the dot is expiring.
Use Channel Demonfire on cooldown if talented.
Cast Incinerate as your filler to generate Soul Shards when no other priorities are available.
